intro_notes: NOTE: The Artificial Intelligence (AI) merit badge has no merit badge pamphlet. Instead, it has been designed for you to interact with the Scoutly chatbot on your learning journey as you work through the requirements. Scoutly can be found on the bottom right of your browser at https://scouting.org. If you have a question about a requirement, ask Scoutly! Hint: try asking Scoutly to Explain the "xxx" activity for requirement "yy" of the AI merit badge. This does not replace the requirement to identify and work with a counselor to complete the badge. Additional educational resources are available on our Counselor Information Page.

requirements.lead_text: Key Concepts. Define the following terms and share the meaning of each with your counselor: artificial intelligence (AI), artificial intelligence agents, automation, basic programming, bots, data, databases, digital workers, general AI, machine learning (ML), narrow AI, superintelligent AI, tasks, triggers, workflows, and variables.

pamphlet_excerpts: Core Standard 1 (Req 1): Define the following terms and share the meaning of each with your counselor: artificial intelligence (AI), artificial intelligence agents, automation.
Key Terminology & Evidence: Document specific examples, definitions, and field observations for Key Concepts in your Artificial Intelligence Workbook.
Safety & Policy Alignment: Follow the BSA Guide to Safe Scouting, Two-Deep Leadership, and the Buddy System during all Artificial Intelligence Req 1 activities.
Counselor Conference Readiness: Be prepared to explain your findings and personal reflections on Key Concepts with your Merit Badge Counselor.
step_by_step_procedure: Step 1 - Review Standard (Req 1): Read the official Artificial Intelligence requirement and identify the key questions, terms, or skills covered in Key Concepts.
Step 2 - Gather Evidence & Examples: Research the required facts in the Artificial Intelligence Pamphlet and record structured notes in your Scout Workbook.
Step 3 - Practice & Apply (Explain): Work with your patrol buddy or family (as required) to explain each element of Key Concepts with concrete real-world examples.
Step 4 - Counselor Conference & Sign-Off: Present your completed workbook organizer and explain your understanding to your Merit Badge Counselor for Blue Card verification.

requirements.lead_text: Artificial Intelligence (AI) Basics. Do the following and share what you learned with your counselor:
requirements.req_text: Artificial Intelligence (AI) Basics. Do the following and share what you learned with your counselor: (a) Identify 10 examples of how AI is currently used in everyday life. (b) Identify five examples of how AI is currently used in the workplace. (c) Identify five examples of how AI can be used at school or in support of your education. (d) Meet with your counselor and play 10 rounds of the "AI or Not?" game to determine if the presented scenario utilizes AI. Discuss your answers. (e) Create a timeline with five key milestones in the development of artificial intelligence.

requirements.lead_text: Practical Application. Do ONE of the following:
requirements.req_text: Practical Application. Do ONE of the following: (a) With your counselor's approval, choose an artificial intelligence project based on your personal interest or a community need. Develop a plan outlining the project's objectives, data requirements, and potential ethical considerations. Implement the project utilizing appropriate artificial intelligence tools, languages, or platforms. Share your project with your counselor. Discuss the steps you followed to create the project and your experience during the process. (b) With your counselor's approval, design a short lesson plan on AI and teach it to your patrol or a group of Scouts. The lesson should include an AI-generated age-appropriate explanation of AI, examples of how AI is used in both everyday life as well as in the workplace, and an interactive demonstration of how Scouts could utilize AI to assist them with a school assignment, Scouting activity, or rank advancement. Share information on the development process and teaching experience with your counselor.

requirements.lead_text: Career Exploration. Do ONE of the following:
requirements.req_text: Career Exploration. Do ONE of the following: (a) Identify three career opportunities that would use skills and knowledge in artificial intelligence or automation. Pick one and research the training, education, certification requirements, experience, and expenses associated with entering the field. Research the prospects for employment, starting salary, advancement opportunities, and career goals associated with this career. Discuss what you learned with your counselor and whether you might be interested in this career. (b) Interview an artificial intelligence or automation professional. Learn about their day-to-day work, the challenges they face, and their vision for the future of artificial intelligence or automation. Inquire about training, education, certification requirements, experience, and expenses associated with entering the field. Share what you learned with your counselor.

sub_requirements.sub_req_text: Identify three career opportunities that would use skills and knowledge in artificial intelligence or automation. Pick one and research the training, education, certification requirements, experience, and expenses associated with entering the field. Research the prospects for employment, starting salary, advancement opportunities, and career goals associated with this career. Discuss what you learned with your counselor and whether you might be interested in this career.

Learn about their day-to-day work, the challenges they face, and their vision for the future of artificial intelligence or automation. Inquire about training, education, certification requirements, experience, and expenses associated with entering the field. Share what you learned with your counselor.

pamphlet_excerpts: Artificial Intelligence Sub-Req 8a: Identify three career opportunities that would use skills and knowledge in artificial intelligence or automation.
Artificial Intelligence Sub-Req 8b: Interview an artificial intelligence or automation professional.
Core Standard 1 (Req 8): Career Exploration.
Core Standard 2 (Req 8): Do ONE of the following: (a) Identify three career opportunities that would use skills and knowledge in artificial intelligence or automation.
step_by_step_procedure: Step 1 - Review Standard (Req 8): Read the official Artificial Intelligence requirement and identify the key questions, terms, or skills covered in Careers & Professional Pathways.
Step 2 - Gather Evidence & Examples: Research the required facts in the Artificial Intelligence Pamphlet and record structured notes in your Scout Workbook.
Step 3 - Practice & Apply (Identify): Work with your patrol buddy or family (as required) to identify each element of Careers & Professional Pathways with concrete real-world examples.
Step 4 - Counselor Conference & Sign-Off: Present your completed workbook organizer and identify your understanding to your Merit Badge Counselor for Blue Card verification.
